title: 第22章 误闯天家！考古队遭重创！
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
与“破壁者”那种惊天动地的声势不同，它的声音很小，甚至有些沉闷。

    肉眼也看不到任何变化。

    但是，所有靠近的人都能感觉到，无形的，高频率的震动，正通过那个金属盘，源源不断地传递到青铜门之内。

    一秒。

    两秒。

    十秒。

    青铜门依旧纹丝不动，没有任何反应。

    演播厅里，陈振博士的嘴角，不易察觉地向上翘了翘。

    弹幕也开始出现一些嘲讽的声音。

    【看吧，我就说没用。】

    【浪费电，还不如再撞几下呢。】

    【金大师，你倒是说句话呀？】

    然而，金世昌却依旧是一副老神在在的样子，他双眼微闭，在感知着什么。

    就在第二十秒的时候。

    异变陡生！

    现场的考古队员们忽然发出一阵惊呼。

    “快看！门上的花纹！”

    只见那扇巨大的青铜门上，那些原本只是镌刻着的，死物的诡异符文，竟然……

    亮了起来！

    一道道如同血液红光，顺着那些符文的纹路，从四面八方亮起，飞快地朝着中心那个被“震荡锤”攻击的点汇聚而去。

    整个过程，快如闪电！

    “不好！快退后！”

    林薇脸色大变，她敏锐地感觉到了极度危险的气息。

    但是，已经晚了。

    当所有的红光都汇聚到中心点的那一刻。

    “嗡！！！”

    一声来自九幽地狱的轰鸣，猛地从青铜门内爆发出来！

    肉眼可见的，如同涟漪能量冲击波，以那个中心点为圆心，轰然扩散！

    “砰！砰！砰！”

    首当其冲的“震荡锤”，那台由特种合金打造的精密设备，在一瞬间就被震成了漫天零件！

    紧接着，冲击波扫过了距离最近的几名考古队员。

    “啊！”

    他们惨叫一声，连人带设备，被狠狠地掀飞了出去，重重地撞在后方的岩壁上，当场昏死过去。

    林薇也被这股巨力波及，她闷哼一声，感觉自己被一头高速行驶的卡车给撞了，五脏六腑都错了位，喉头一甜，一口鲜血喷了出来。

    整个现场，一片混乱！

    演播厅里，所有人都被这突如其来的变故惊得魂飞魄散！

    “快！快切断现场信号！呼叫医疗队！”
content_en:
Unlike the earth-shattering momentum of "Wall Breaker", its voice is small, even a little dull.

    No changes can be seen with the naked eye.

    However, everyone who is close can feel invisible, high-frequency vibrations, which are continuously transmitted to the bronze door through the metal plate.

    One second.

    Two seconds.

    Ten seconds.

    The bronze door remained motionless and showed no reaction.

    In the studio, the corners of Dr. Chen Zhen's mouth turned up imperceptibly.

    Some sarcastic voices also began to appear on the barrage.

    [Look, I just said it’s useless. 】

    [Wasting electricity, might as well hit it a few more times. 】

    [Master Jin, would you like to say something? 】

    However, Jin Shichang still looked like the old god was there, his eyes were slightly closed, and he was sensing something.

    Just at the twentieth second.

    A sudden change occurred!

    The archaeological team members at the scene suddenly exclaimed.

    "Look! The pattern on the door!"

    I saw that on the huge bronze door, those strange runes that were originally just engraved with dead objects turned out to be...

    Light up!

    Rays of blood-red light followed the lines of the runes and lit up from all directions, quickly converging towards the point in the center that was attacked by the "Concussion Hammer".

    The whole process is as fast as lightning!

    "No! Back away!"

    Lin Wei's expression changed drastically, and she keenly felt the aura of extreme danger.

    But, it's too late.

    The moment when all the red light converges to the center point.

    “Buzz!!!”

    A roar from the Nine Nether Hell suddenly erupted from the bronze door!

    Visible to the naked eye, it is like a ripple energy shock wave, taking that center point as the center of the circle and spreading suddenly!

    "Bang! Bang! Bang!"

    The "Vibration Hammer" that bore the brunt of the attack, that precision equipment made of special alloy, was shattered into parts all over the place in an instant!

    Immediately afterwards, the shock wave swept across the nearest archaeological team members.

    "Ah!"

    They screamed and were violently thrown away, including their equipment and their bodies. They hit the rock wall behind them hard and fainted on the spot.

    Lin Wei was also affected by this huge force. She groaned, feeling like she had been hit by a high-speed truck. Her internal organs were all out of place, her throat felt sweet, and a mouthful of blood spurted out.

    The entire scene was in chaos!

    Everyone in the studio was shocked by this sudden turn of events!

    "Quick! Cut off the on-site signal! Call the medical team!"
title_en: Chapter 22 Breaking into Tianjia by mistake! The archaeological team suffered a heavy blow!
